citation.title: Real-time MSE measurements for current profile control on KSTAR
citation.authors: M. F. M. De Bock; D. Aussems; R. Huijgen; M. Scheffer; J. Chung

topic: Design considerations for a real-time motional Stark effect (MSE) polarimetry diagnostic on KSTAR. The diagnostic measures magnetic field pitch and q profile, not CES ion temperature.
own_question: How should real-time MSE be built on KSTAR? The paper considers three elements: PEM retardance retrieved from the signal itself, interference-filter selection under beam-spectrum overlap, and a custom multi-channel, multi-harmonic phase-locking algorithm.
actual_method_and_evidence: The evidence is a lab laser scan of the PEM retardance profile, spectral simulations comparing filter designs, and a phase-locking demonstration on MAST MSE data. The authors report locking within 0.5 degrees about 10 ms after beam switch-on, for a 1 MHz signal analysed at 1 kHz. No KSTAR real-time deployment is reported. Figures were not visually checked.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: On KSTAR, real-time core diagnostics such as MSE have been motivated by q-profile control for long-pulse advanced scenarios.
claim_checks.qualification: This is the authors' stated motivation and a design study. It is not achieved control. It concerns MSE, not CES.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: This concerns MSE polarization processed at 1 kHz on MAST data. It has no CES, BES or ECEI inputs, no report-arrival timing, and no nowcasting target.
validation_if_relevant: Validation is an offline comparison against post-shot analysis on a MAST dataset, plus simulations. There is no KSTAR held-out validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite it as evidence about CES ion temperature, its latency, or its availability.
Do not claim real-time MSE was operational on KSTAR.
Do not transfer the 10 ms locking result to our 10 ms computation budget.
Do not cite it as prior nowcasting or machine-learning work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most this is optional background showing that KSTAR real-time diagnostic needs have been discussed for profile control. It does not address impurity-ion CES temperature, BES/ECEI inputs, or temporal estimation. Omitting it loses nothing essential.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
